frontmatter.title: How to Load Presentations Python

blocks.content: Aspose.Slides enables loading presentations in common formats such as PPTX, PPT, and PDF using the `Presentation` class from the `aspose_slides_foss` package. Developers working with python slides library can load slide python pptx files for further processing, analysis, or conversion.
Aspose.Slides -- Required installation and import statements.
For details on prerequisites, see the Aspose.Slides documentation.

Aspose.Slides for Python via .NET enables loading presentations from file paths, streams, or byte arrays using the `Presentation` class. Developers can specify load behavior through `LoadOptions`, such as handling password-protected files or ignoring errors during load.

To load a presentation from a file path, instantiate `Presentation` with the path to a `.pptx`, `.ppt`, or other supported format. For stream-based loading—such as from memory, network, or cloud storage—pass a readable stream object to the `Presentation` constructor. When additional control is needed, pass a `LoadOptions` instance alongside the source to configure loading behavior like password decryption or error handling.

This section covers the most common scenarios for loading presentations in Python slides workflows, including handling local files and in-memory streams. For beginners exploring python slides library capabilities, understanding how to load files is the first step toward manipulating slides, extracting content, or converting to formats like python slides pdf or slide python pptx.

This section demonstrates how to load a presentation file using Aspose.Slides in Python. The example shows opening a PPTX file, inspecting its basic structure, and printing a summary of its contents. It uses the canonical import path `aspose_slides_foss` and relies solely on documented API surface members.

# Example usage
import aspose_slides_foss
# See API reference for complete examples
Aspose.Slides supports loading presentations from multiple file formats. The `Presentation` class enables loading files for processing, conversion, or manipulation in Python slides workflows.

| Format | Extension | Notes |
|--------|-----------|-------|
| PowerPoint | .ppt, .pptx | Standard Microsoft PowerPoint formats |
| OpenDocument Presentation | .odp | Open standard for presentations |
| Portable Document Format | .pdf | Read-only presentation format |
| SVG | .svg | Scalable Vector Graphics |
| XPS | .xps | XML Paper Specification |
| HTML | .html | Web page format |
| MHTML | .mht, .mhtml | Web archive format |
| TIFF | .tiff | Tagged Image File Format |
| JPEG | .jpg, .jpeg | JPEG image format |
| PNG | .png | Portable Network Graphics |
| BMP | .bmp | Bitmap image format |
| EMF | .emf | Enhanced Metafile format |
| GIF | .gif | Graphics Interchange Format |
| WebP | .webp | Modern image format |
| EPUB | .epub | Electronic publication format |
